title: refactor(ci): modernize build matrix, consolidate lint/test workflows, and bump actions/deps
author: Aisha Khatri
description:
Motivation: Reduce CI runtime and maintenance surface by consolidating duplicate GitHub Actions matrices, standardizing lint/test pipelines across packages, and bumping key GitHub Actions/node versions for security and performance. This PR unifies the most common matrix patterns, improves caching keys, and tightens parallelism for large suites. It also updates the release automation workflows to use latest recommended actions and removes legacy Node 16 support.

Summary of changes: consolidated build/test matrix into .github/workflows/build.yml to avoid duplicate matrix runs across packages; split lint and unit test workflows into separate, smaller runs to improve cache locality; updated release.yml to actions/checkout@v4 and actions/cache@v4; bumped common action versions used in the monorepo and updated node versions in matrices to [18,20] (removed 16); added explicit cache-key seeds and restored deterministic restore/paths for pnpm workspace installs; added Dependabot gating to reduce noisy CI runs; adjusted concurrency/grouping to reduce queue thrash; added a small helper script scripts/ci/cache-keys.sh used by workflows to compute stable keys.

Checklist: - [x] run full CI matrix locally (replay of GitHub Actions using act) - [x] validation of pnpm workspace install times with new cache keys - [x] e2e smoke runs in dedicated runner to reproduce flaky docker build issues - [x] coordinated roll for release workflow with SRE to ensure no regression on publish cadence

Why now: CI minutes and failures have been trending up as more packages were added to the monorepo. Consolidation and action bumps should lower overall runtime and improve cache hit rates while removing an unsupported Node version.

Notes on rollback: changes are non-breaking to code; rolling back is a single PR that restores prior workflow files. Release workflow change is guarded by a repo setting (require approvals) and tested in a canary repo before merging here.
